prompts.sword:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production concept and color texture source for one actual 3D fantasy MMORPG two-handed sword.
Primary request: "Twilight of the Blue Moon" — noble, sacred azure beauty. Completely new design, an elegant high-tier blue lunar sword whose identity reads as BLUE MOON even at small game size. Predominantly rich luminous royal azure, deep ultramarine and pearlescent moon-blue; tiny restrained pale-silver highlights only. It must NOT read as an iron or grey steel weapon painted blue. Smooth enchanted moonstone, opaline lunar surfaces, richly designed cobalt facets and flowing lunar inlays, not icy icicles.
Shape: long graceful lethal blade, convincingly thin cutting edges and strongly tapering sharp point; slightly asymmetric sweeping silhouette, a few elegant irregular lunar fins. A large unmistakable azure crescent is structurally integrated into the openwork guard/base of the blade, with real negative space and layered supporting curves; not a circular sticker or an extra flat emblem. Its luminous crescent shape remains bold and recognizable. Noble ceremonial craftsmanship, exquisite blue-on-blue surface detail, restrained inner light contained INSIDE the weapon. Dark blue wrapped grip.
Composition: ONLY ONE complete sword, perfectly straight upright, point at top, grip and pommel below, full front orthographic view with NO perspective foreshortening, generous clean margin, weapon fills a tall portrait canvas. Neutral balanced illumination gives distinct face, edge bevel and layered forms. Polished hand-painted fantasy game asset presentation, crisp contour and clear usable surface texture, high visual quality.
Background: genuine transparent alpha background, no cast shadow. No scenery, no ground, no text, no labels, no watermark, no other objects, no characters, no particles or rays, no detached aura, no fog. No gritty black iron, no bulky blunt blade, no dominant grey/silver, no large warm gold areas.
prompts.bow:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production concept and color texture source for one actual 3D fantasy MMORPG longbow.
Primary request: "Twilight of the Blue Moon" — noble, sacred azure beauty. Completely new design, an elegant high-tier blue lunar longbow whose identity reads as BLUE MOON even at small game size. A bold azure crescent is structurally integrated around the CENTRAL GRIP as a crescent-shaped openwork body with real negative space and offset supporting arcs, not a sticker or a pasted disk. Upper and lower limbs are visibly distinct, connected by a strong refined central structure.
